summary.text: Jennifer Carroll Foy is a Democratic member of the Senate of Virginia representing District 33.
The Senate biography lists Jennifer Carroll Foy's service in the House of Delegates from 2018 to 2020 and in the Senate since 2024.

paragraphs.text: According to the Senate biography, Jennifer Carroll Foy was born in Petersburg, Virginia, on September 25, 1981.
Jennifer Carroll Foy studied at the Virginia Military Institute, Virginia State University, and Thomas Jefferson School of Law, with degrees listed as B.A., M.A., and J.D.
Jennifer Carroll Foy's listed occupation is attorney.
The biography lists Jeffrey Foy as Jennifer Carroll Foy's spouse.
The Senate page lists Jennifer Carroll Foy's committee assignments as Courts of Justice, General Laws and Technology, Privileges and Elections, and Rehabilitation and Social Services.
